lessons.title: Welcome to the Leads to Deals Formula
sum: Why I close with data shown in the right order, not with talk.
How the Academy works: short lessons, then real case studies from my own deals (won and lost, no client details).
The path: before the call → the call → presentation → objections → closing → after the sale.

lessons.title: Read the lead in 2 minutes
sum: Fast and blind loses leads: take 2 minutes before you dial.
Check 4 things: who it is, the words they used (home/family = end-user; ROI/rent = investor; golden visa = AED 2M mark), where they came from, their time and country.
Write one lead line before every call: it decides your whole pitch.
lessons.tpl: Lead line: [who] · [buyer / investor / visa] · [source] · [area or project] · [best time to call]

lessons.title: Run the report before you call, not after
sum: If the client knows a number before you, you've lost the room.
One minute in DealPro: price per sq ft vs the area, upcoming supply, developer and escrow, exit scenarios.
Open with one fact they don't know; after the call send the full report with your name on it.
lessons.tpl: 1 minute · 1 report · 1 fact they don't know

lessons.title: The 3 questions that decide your pitch
sum: Live in or investment? It changes everything: schools and community, or rent, yield and exit.
Budget including fees (say the 4% DLD fee first), and cash or mortgage.
When will you decide, and why now? The 'why now' is what you come back to at 'let me think about it'.
lessons.tpl: 1. Live in or investment?  2. Budget including fees, cash or mortgage?  3. When to decide, and why now?
